"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { PageHeaderBlock } from "@raydenui/ui/blocks";
import "@raydenui/ui/styles.css";
export default function Example({ state = "default" }: { state?: string }) {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("Choose an action to try this project header.");
  const [approved, setApproved] = useState(false);
  const [recovered, setRecovered] = useState(false);
  return <div style={{ width: "100%" }}><PageHeaderBlock title="A new chapter for Northline." eyebrow="BRAND PROJECT" description="A considered identity for a fictional independent studio." breadcrumbs={[{ id: "workspace", label: "Workspace", onClick: () => setMessage("Workspace selected in this demo.") }, { id: "projects", label: "Projects", onClick: () => setMessage("Projects selected in this demo.") }, { id: "northline", label: "Northline" }]} status={{ label: approved ? "Approved" : "In review", tone: approved ? "success" : "warning" }} meta={[{ id: "owner", label: "Owner", value: "Avery Morgan" }, { id: "due", label: "Due", value: "28 September 2026" }]} actions={[{ id: "approve", label: "Approve demo", priority: "primary", onClick: () => { setApproved(true); setMessage("Demo project approved locally."); } }, { id: "share", label: "Share preview", onClick: () => setMessage("Sharing selected. No message or invitation was sent.") }, { id: "archive", label: "Archive project", priority: "overflow", onClick: () => setMessage("Demo project archived locally.") }, { id: "delete", label: "Delete project", priority: "overflow", unavailableReason: "Only the demo owner can delete projects." }]} variant={state === "plain" ? "plain" : "surface"} state={!recovered && (state === "loading" || state === "error") ? state : "default"} onRetry={() => setRecovered(true)} /><p role="status" style={{ marginTop: 32 }}>{message}</p></div>;
}

Made for real interfaces.

A project header combines breadcrumbs, metadata, status and an action overflow. The approval action updates local state; unavailable deletion explains why it cannot be used.

Try it

Approve the demo, follow a breadcrumb, and open More actions. Compare the plain and error states.

The Code tab contains the full preview component. Import the stylesheet once in your app. Preview state changes reset local data. This block is experimental; review its documented limitations before using it in your product.
